ConsoleUI.SecurityNotice: Commands run with super user rights, as on the command line, and are written to the Matomo logs.
ConsoleUI.InputPlaceholder: Type a command, for example core:archive or list
ConsoleUI.OutputEmpty: Type a command below, or pick one in the command library. Its output will appear here.
ConsoleUI.OutputTruncated: The output is too long, the rest is not displayed. The command keeps running until it ends.
ConsoleUI.ConnectionLost: The connection was lost before the command ended. It may still be running on the server, check the Matomo logs.
ConsoleUI.UnexpectedError: An unexpected error occurred, see the Matomo logs for details.
ConsoleUI.PasswordConfirmationExpired: Your password confirmation has expired. Reload the page and confirm your password again.
ConsoleUI.KeyboardHints: Tab accepts a suggestion, Up and Down browse the suggestions or your history, Ctrl+C stops the running command, Ctrl+L clears the output.
ConsoleUI.CommandNotAllowed: The command "%s" cannot be run from the browser on this Matomo.
ConsoleUI.CommandTooLong: The command is too long, %s characters at most.
ConsoleUI.CommandInvalidCharacters: The command must fit on a single line, without control characters.
ConsoleUI.PostRequired: This action only accepts POST requests.
ConsoleUI.Disabled: The console is disabled on this Matomo by the server administrator, with enabled = 0 in the [ConsoleUI] section of config/config.ini.php.
ConsoleUI.OptionNotAllowed: These options cannot be used from the browser: %s.
